reason: It's free and I just log in with my college account, so I'd install it, and I did miss a deadline last semester because a notice got buried in a WhatsApp group. I'd probably open it once a week to copy new deadlines into my Notion, but only if it actually has everything.
objection: Half our profs and CRs still post changes on WhatsApp first, so if UniDash is missing even one notice I'll stop trusting it and it's just one more app on my phone next to Calendar and Notion.
would_change_my_mind: If after the first couple of weeks I see a deadline on WhatsApp that never showed up in UniDash, I'd drop it.
